text.p: Results of Brazilian
soccer matches played at the weekend.
Sao Paulo championship, final stage
Sao Paulo 1 Santos 0
Corinthians 2 Palmeiras 0
Final stage standings (tabulate under played, won, drawn,
lost, goals for, goals against, points, points in qualifying
stage)
Corinthians 2 2 0 0 6 3 6 45
Sao Paulo 2 2 0 0 5 1 6 40
Palmeiras 2 0 0 2 1 6 0 48
Santos 2 0 0 2 3 5 0 46
Note: if teams are level on points, positions are decided by
the number of points in the qualifying stage. Teams play each
other once in the final stage.
Rio de Janeiro championship, third stage
Americano 2 Bangu 1
Note: postponed until a date to be arranged: Vasco da Gama v
Flamengo, Botafogo v Fluminense. Rio de Janeiro football
federation suspended the games at the request of Vasco who have
two players with the Brazil national team. Botafogo and Flamengo
have one player each with the national team.
Third stage standings (tabulate under played, won, drawn,
lost, goals for, goals against, points)
Vasco da Gama 4 2 2 0 9 3 8
Fluminense 4 2 2 0 7 4 8
Americano 4 1 2 1 4 4 5
Botafogo 4 1 2 1 4 5 5
Flamengo 3 1 1 1 2 3 4
Note: the winners of the first, second and third stages
qualify for the final round. Only the top eight in the first
stage go into the second stage and the top six teams in the
second stage carry on into the third stage. If the same team
wins all three stages, they become champions automatically.
First stage winners - Botafogo
Second stage winners - Botafogo
Eliminated in the first stage - Itaperuna, America, Olaria,
Barreira.
Eliminated in the second stage - Madureira, Volta Redonda
